definitions.explanation: The process of distributing goods from producers to consumers through various channels; also refers to the circulation of money or information.

examples.japanese: {商品|しょうひん}の{流通|りゅうつう}を{管理|かんり}する。
examples.english: To manage the distribution of products.

examples.japanese: {流通|りゅうつう}{経路|けいろ}を{短縮|たんしゅく}する。
{偽造品|ぎぞうひん}が{市場|しじょう}に{流通|りゅうつう}している。
examples.english: Counterfeit goods are circulating in the market.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {流通|りゅうつう}する (to circulate, to distribute)
- {流通|りゅうつう}{経路|けいろ} (distribution channel)
- {流通|りゅうつう}{業|ぎょう} (distribution industry)
- {流通|りゅうつう}コスト (distribution costs)

RELATED TERMS:
- {物流|ぶつりゅう} (logistics)
- {販売|はんばい} (sales)
